text: 下周科技股财报密集来袭，苹果(AAPL.O)、Meta Platforms(META.O)、亚马逊(AMZN.O)、微软(MSFT.O)、高通(QCOM.O)、SK海力士等个股将于下周公布财报。经济数据方面，中国7月官方制造业PMI；美国6月PCE、小非农就业人数，二季度实际GDP年化季率初值等数据将于下周公布。此外，美联储将于下周公布利率决议，敬请留意。完整个股财报日历请前往美港电讯APP—日历查看。点击查看...
text_en: Next week is heavy with tech earnings reports: Apple (AAPL.O), Meta Platforms (META.O), Amazon (AMZN.O), Microsoft (MSFT.O), Qualcomm (QCOM.O), SK Hynix, and others will release their quarterly results. On the economic data front, China's July official manufacturing PMI; US June PCE, ADP employment change, and Q2 annualized real GDP initial estimate are due next week. Additionally, the Federal Reserve will announce its interest rate decision next week. Stay tuned. View the full earnings calendar in the US Stock Express app under Calendar. Click to view...
